blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Top justice officials on Monday vowed to turn inter-agency cooperation into concrete action against graft and corruption, warning that agreements must lead to results. The Justice Sector Coordinating Council (JSCC) and the Office of the Ombudsman signed a memorandum of understanding on Monday to strengthen cooperation in administering justice, promoting public accountability and combating corruption. The agreement brings the Ombudsman into the JSCC’s inter-agency partnership alongside the judiciary, the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).
